subject: Mobile Development
title: Freemium: The Dominant Model
description: A quick win: understand Freemium: The Dominant Model.

hook.text: The app is free to download. But if you want the good stuff, you'll need to pay.

buildup.text: Freemium gives basic features for free and charges for premium upgrades or content.

discovery.text: Spotify, Duolingo, and Tinder all use freemium. Free users become paying customers over time.

twist.text: Only 2-5% of users ever convert to paid. The rest use the free tier forever.

climax.text: Freemium works because a tiny percentage of paying users funds millions of free ones.

punchline.text: 5% of payers support 95% of free users.

quiz.question: What percentage of freemium users typically convert to paid?
